priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore listener removal in the returned disposer
findings.body: `attach` still returns a cleanup callback, but that callback now does nothing. After callers invoke it, the handler continues receiving messages; repeated attachment can also accumulate duplicate listeners and retain associated resources indefinitely.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts:3 still returns an empty disposer after registering handler on line 2; the removed base line called socket.off("message", handler), so invoking cleanup no longer unregisters the listener.
